payload.summary: Pivot from per-slot RemoteTrigger to dev-team-pattern master cron. Single */15 CronCreate + cowork-team.md slash command reads cowork-schedule.json, matches current UTC +/-2min, parallel-spawns all matching agents. Resolves API_MIN_INTERVAL blockage on 4 sub-hourly slots. Includes schema additions, match algorithm, parallel-spawn rules, idempotency guard, cutover plan (delete 12 RemoteTriggers after 24h parallel-run), telemetry spec, 9 failure modes, 10 ACs.
